title: Audio Task Exhausted Event
description: An enrichment pass over a transcription has FAILED at its final permitted attempt: the sweep bound was reached and nothing will re-drive it automatically. This is the dead-letter signal of the Wax enrichment pipeline — the item stays `enrichment_pending`, its transcription.completed and any pass-declared events remain withheld, and a human (or a version bump, which resets the budget) must intervene. Emitted at most once per (item, pass, version): the producer stamps passes.exhausted_at when firing, and a registry version bump clears it. dependency_failed rows never exhaust this way (the pass never ran; its gate lifts when a different pass succeeds) — but a dependency that exhausts strands its dependents, so consumers should treat one exhaustion as a whole-subgraph stall. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

data.description: Payload for bloodbank.audio.task.exhausted. One exhausted enrichment pass.

item_id.description: Wax item id (also the transcription_id) whose pass exhausted.

ep_slug.description: Registry slug of the pass that exhausted (e.g. title-slug, diarization, ticketable).

attempt.description: The attempt number that failed last, i.e. the budget that was used up (sweep bound at emission time).

version.description: Registry version of the pass definition that exhausted. Bumping the version resets the budget and clears exhausted_at.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable failure reason of the final attempt (e.g. nonzero_exit, timeout, result_apply_failed, or a pass-reported code). Never dependency_failed.

detail.description: First line of the final attempt's detail, for triage without opening the ledger.

project.description: Producer bucketing key stamped on every Wax event for Candystore ('wax').
